title: Graphs of operators as points in the Grassmann manifold
summary: We study the set $Γ$ of graphs of closed, densely defined operators in a Hilbert space $H$, regarded as a subset of the Grassmann manifold $P(H\times H)$ of orthogonal projections in $H\times H$. We show that the subset $Γ^b$ of graphs of bounded operators is the open unit ball of $P(H\times H)$ centered at the graph of the zero operator $P_0$ (which projects onto $H\times\{0\}$). This ball is diffeomorphic to $B(H)$ via the map $T\mapsto P_T$ ($=$ the projection onto the graph ${Gr(T)}$ of $T$). We show that graphs of unbounded closed operators lie at the boundary of $Γ$.
